## **Posting for another group member who wishes to stay anonymous**

Hello group. I’m going through insolvency, I can’t exit the country because of it and I don’t earn a lot, about half the minimum wage and i just received an email from misrad hapnim asking a 30,000 shekels guaranty for my wife how should i proceed from here? Should i go to their office Sunday morning and show them all my documents that i am unable to pay a guaranty? One of the reasons for the guaranty stated in their response, was, that i didn’t visit my wife outside of the country for more than a year but I couldn’t leave since i have an exit ban because of my insolvency. How to proceed ? Thank you.
